description: Defines data models for pricing resolution requests and responses within the pricing service, including immutable record classes for request parameters and pricing results.

classes.name: PricingResolutionModels
classes.description: Contains nested record classes for immutable pricing resolution request and response data.

methods.name: PricingResolutionRequest
methods.description: Immutable record representing a request for pricing resolution, including store code, SKU, currency, quantity, and timestamp.

methods.name: PricingResolution
methods.description: Immutable record representing the pricing resolution result, including various price details, timestamps, and price types.
